drive car1 myagang-shelter gosaikunda-temple
load car1 adult 1
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple myagang-shelter

</plan>
COST: 154

This rescues all 6 people with no deferrals. Gosaikunda temple connects only to Myagang shelter (the Dhunche farm road is impassable), so the car must make a round trip there (102 min). Suryagadhi market is a 26-minute round trip (52 min). Both legs are the shortest available routes, so 154 is the minimum cost. The car carries 3 people on the second trip, within its 4-seat capacity.
